confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are based on aggregated crowdsourced cost-of-living data from web searches. Numbeo and Expatica show a mid-range meal for two at about CHF 150-158, and Citycost shows about CHF 148 (about USD 179). MyLifeElsewhere shows an inexpensive meal at about CHF 25, a local pint at CHF 6-7.9 and a cappuccino at CHF 3.65-3.9. Expatistan gives a cocktail at CHF 14, but from a small sample. I converted CHF to USD at about 1.23 USD per CHF, inferred from the USD equivalents on those pages. Beer and coffee were nudged up slightly for restaurant settings and July tourist season. I found no aggregated per-glass wine price, so wine is estimated from its usual Swiss relationship to beer (a 1 dl glass at about CHF 7-9) and is less certain. The cocktail figure was raised modestly for tourist-area bars and lakefront venues. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak lakeside season. They draw on general knowledge of Swiss pricing and Lugano's limited hostel supply. They are not based on any live listings and are the least certain anchors, with dorm and private-hostel figures plausibly varying by ±20%.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lugano's restaurant prices are close to the Swiss average, slightly below it according to MyLifeElsewhere. Accommodation was benchmarked against other Swiss lake resort cities such as Lucerne and Locarno in high summer. These are somewhat below Zurich and Geneva levels but well above prices in nearby northern Italian lake towns.
